title: chore(deps): move .objectstack-sha to objectstack 18.0.0 version commit 06cab4849a (objectui#13261)
body:
Fixes #13261
Clause-②: no

**Scope:** move `.objectstack-sha` from `f4755a68a797` to `06cab4849a8a616487d468a11dd370e929137990`, objectstack's 18.0.0 version commit. Then fix every test the pin delta turns red, with no skip and no retry-wrap. The pin does not go past `06cab4849a`.

## The pin

- `git rev-parse 'refs/tags/@objectstack/spec@18.0.0^{}'` and `git ls-remote origin` for the same ref both answer `06cab4849a8a616487d468a11dd370e929137990` (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24524, "chore: version packages").
- `git merge-base --is-ancestor 06cab4849a origin/main` exits 0 in the objectstack checkout (origin/main `a8b44d4070`). Exit 0 holds in a shallow checkout too.
- The pin and the seven packed manifests in `.objectstack-pin/` were written by `scripts/bump-objectstack.sh --no-commit 06cab4849a…` and committed together in `d51d0408ae`. The bump read a detached objectstack worktree at the target. The script reported "(on origin/main)", and the build ran under the verify lock with `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- In the manifests, only version strings move (`18.0.0-next.5` to `18.0.0`). No dependency name changes.
- **`pnpm-lock.yaml` is unchanged.** The printed second half, `pnpm install`, rewrote it, but only by flipping which `esbuild` peer context vite resolves under two importers (`0.27.7` and `0.28.2`). Nothing in that diff comes from the pinned packages. I restored the committed lockfile and ran `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, which exits 0. `check:lockfile-integrity` reads clean and `check:lockfile-dedupe` reads deduped.
- **Floor:** `node scripts/objectstack-floor.mjs --dry-run` exits 0 with "Floor 18.0.0: the earliest published @objectstack/spec whose tag @objectstack/spec@18.0.0 contains the pin 06cab4849a8a616487d468a11dd370e929137990." It reports 37 ranges that would move to `^18.0.0` at publish and writes nothing.

## Reds at the new pin, and what this PR does

| Red | Upstream commit | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `registry-inputs-spec-parity`: 3 rows about `list-view.filterableFields` | `4bc3becd5f` (objectstack#24640) | The `UNPUBLISHED_EXEMPTIONS` entry leaves, as it said it would at this pin. The key is now a harvested tombstone |
| `object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779`: 13 rows | `4bc3becd5f` | The sixth census bucket (`BUCKET_SPEC_RETIRED_AHEAD_OF_PIN`) empties into `PROTOCOL_RETIRED_KEYS` (now 8) and `BUCKET_PROTOCOL_RETIRED_TOMBSTONED` (now 3), as its failure message prescribed. The live count goes 44 to 43. The accept legs parse the seven live mirrored keys. A new row pins that `filterableFields` is refused by name on both entry paths with the spec's prescription. The "legacy shorthand" description row is inverted to the `[REMOVED]` marker |
| `object-view-spec-parity`: the `filterableFields` anchor reads RETIRED | `4bc3becd5f` | Re-triaged at this bump, as its note said it would be: out of `SPEC_COUNTERPART` and into `SANCTIONED_LOCAL`, on the same footing as `viewTabBar` (a tombstone still declared on both faces) |
| `ListViewBlock.specInputs-13047`: 2 rows | `4bc3becd5f` | The spec's `list-view` row now refuses the fixture. One row pins that refusal (path `filterableFields`, prescription text, plus an accept control). The Filter-panel measurement is kept on a node built past the row on purpose. The old quick-filter-bar row is removed: no node the save gate accepts can carry the key now |
| `SchemaForm.topLevelUnion-11251`: the served list form | `4bc3becd5f` (`view.form.ts` drops the input) | The control lists the three keys the form still offers, and pins `filterableFields` absent |
| `ci-cd-pipeline-doc`: live-e2e pin | the bump | `e2e/live/ci/backend.env` reads `OBJECTSTACK_VERSION=18.0.0`. The tag `@objectstack/cli@18.0.0^{}` resolves to `06cab4849a`, and npm serves `@objectstack/cli@18.0.0` |
| `check:installed-pin-claims` and its blocking test: 34 sentences in 24 files | the bump | Each fact was re-measured and the sentence restamped `18.0.0` (see below). Nine sentences that carry the re-measure chain also gain `objectui#13261` |

The renderer needed no change. objectui#13118 had already removed the `filterableFields` reader ahead of the pin.

### How the 34 sentences were re-measured

I wrote a probe and ran it unchanged against both builds in the pin store: `f4755a68` (`18.0.0-next.5`) and `06cab4849a` (`18.0.0`). For every exported zod schema in `@objectstack/spec`, `/ui`, `/data` and `/automation` (510 schemas), plus every `ComponentPropsMap` row, it hashes `z.toJSONSchema`. It also runs the concrete parses the sentences state:

- `ViewDataSchema` providers;
- the three `CalendarConfigSchema` legs and the `object-calendar` `data` arms;
- the `FieldSchema` lookup `referenceTo` / `reference` pair, `rows` on four types, and `dependsOn` shapes;
- `SelectOptionSchema` with label `''` and with `description`;
- `record:highlights` `icon` and `layout: 'grid'`, and `record:details` `columns`;
- the `object-kanban` key set and the `ObjectListViewSchema` key count;
- `@objectstack/lint`'s `fieldRuleRootIssue` text for `current_user` and `app`.

Results:

- Every concrete parse answers identically on both builds.
- With descriptions stripped, 15 schemas differ. All of them are the list-view family (the `filterableFields` tombstone) or schemas that embed it (`ObjectSchema`, `ViewSchema`, the stack and artifact aggregates).
- `FieldSchema`, `FlowSchema` and `RecordRelatedListProps` differ in descriptions only.
- For the engine table in `flow-node-config.startGates-12780`: between the two commits, the automation engine changed only run-as identity, and the trigger packages changed only their changelogs and manifests.

## Verification at head `586a6233b5`

- **Closure build** under the verify lock: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2` with `--filter` set to `@object-ui/app-shell^...`, `@object-ui/plugin-view^...`, `@object-ui/data-objectstack^...` and `@object-ui/plugin-list^...`, then `build`. The lock printed `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **Type-check**, each exit 0: `@object-ui/types`, `core`, `data-objectstack`, `plugin-list`, `plugin-view` and `app-shell`. Each log echoes `type-check`. `types`, `plugin-list` and `app-shell` were re-run after the test edits.
- **Targeted vitest** with `--maxWorkers=1`, one package directory at a time, under the lock. These are the 106 test files that name a key or symbol the delta moved (`filterableFields`, `NavigationItemSchema` / `navItemVisibleDataNeedsDataSource`, the spec forms, `retiredKey`, the pin and lockfile scripts), plus `check-installed-spec-pin-claims.test.ts`.
  - First run at the new pin: 18 groups, red in `apps/console`, `app-shell`, `plugin-list`, `types` and `scripts`. Those are the reds in the table.
  - Re-run at `586a6233b5`: `apps/console` 325/325, `app-shell` 620 passed and 1 skipped, `plugin-list` 220/220, `types` 658/658, `scripts` 318/318.
  - The 13 other groups were green at the new pin, before the comment-only restamps.
- **Gates at `586a6233b5`**, each exit 0:
  - `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers` and `handler-key-reads`;
  - `check:side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity` and `designer-field-key-parity`;
  - `check:icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity` and `control-bytes`;
  - `check:installed-pin-claims`, `lockfile-integrity`, `lockfile-dedupe` and `new-line-citations`;
  - `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs` and `check-changeset-presence.mjs`;
  - `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `changeset:check` and `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`.
- **`check:spec-floors`** exits 1, with every finding `[no-artifact]`: the workspace was not fully built. This is NOT MEASURED, not a red. The order said to record it and leave it.
- **Lint, narrowed:** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 27 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files reports `files 27, errors 0`. All 147 warnings sit on lines this PR does not change. `eslint.config.js` has no `parserOptions.project` and no projectService, so type-aware linting is off and this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file.
- **Declared to CI:** the full `pnpm test` (every package directory this PR touches, including `plugin-calendar`, `plugin-designer`, `plugin-detail`, `plugin-form`, `plugin-gantt`, `plugin-kanban` and `core`), the whole-repo `pnpm lint`, `type-check` across the workspace, and `spec-range-floors`.

## Changeset

`.changeset/13261-objectstack-pin-18-0-0.md` has an empty frontmatter, so it releases nothing. The only published-source edits are doc comments, which `check-changeset-presence` counts. It reads OK on the empty declaration.

## Acceptance notes

- `pnpm install` at this pin rewrites `pnpm-lock.yaml` with an `esbuild` peer-context flip that the pin did not cause. It is left uncommitted, because the committed lockfile installs frozen. A later unrelated `pnpm install` may show the same churn.
- `packages/plugin-detail` and `packages/types` still declare `@objectstack/spec` `^18.0.0-next.5` in `package.json`. The floor step moves every range to `^18.0.0` at publish, so this PR leaves them.
- objectui#13121, #13119, #13076 and #12484 remain open. Releasing them after this lands is triage's call.
